newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria registers five political parties.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria registers five political parties.

text.p: Nigeria's electoral commission on Monday said it had registered five of 15 aspiring political parties to take part in the military government's plan to restore democracy.

"It is my pleasure to formally announce that the following five political associations are hereby registered as political parties," electoral commission chairman Sumner Dagogo-Jack said in a statement in the Nigerian capital.
